D.T. Ignacio Jayanti decreased its stake in Enstar Group Ltd (ESGR) by 60.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Corsair Capital Llc sold 431,778 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.76% with the market. The hedge fund run by D.T. Ignacio Jayanti held 286,766 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $57.57 million, down from 718,544 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Corsair Capital Llc who had been investing in Enstar Group Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.12 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.35% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $212.1. About 8,508 shares traded. Enstar Group Limited (NASDAQ:ESGR) has risen 13.09% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.54% the S&P500.
